name: Kwasi Wiredu
shortBio: Ghanaian philosopher who pioneered conceptual decolonization, examining Akan epistemology, non-supernaturalist ontology, and consensus-based democratic political philosophy.
centralQuestion: How can African philosophy decolonize unexamined Western conceptual categories while cultivating critical reflection grounded in indigenous epistemic resources?

keyWorks.title: Philosophy and an African Culture
keyWorks.description: Foundational text addressing anachronisms in tradition, truth as cognitive perspective, and the revitalization of African philosophical inquiry.

keyWorks.title: Cultural Universals and Particulars: An African Perspective
keyWorks.description: Systematic treatise formulating conceptual decolonization, non-party consensus democracy, and Akan ethical humanism.
